name: Original 1D-CNN Forecast (Historical)
description: Initial 1D-CNN point forecast using single seed (42) and sliding window evaluation with test-set checkpoint selection.
notes: Had test-set leakage in checkpoint selection and lacked true time-of-day diurnal profile baseline.

name: Corrected Diurnal Residual TCN Forecast
description: Multi-scale residual TCN with strict validation-based checkpoint selection and multi-seed evaluation (42, 123, 456).
notes: Selected best model by validation MAE (1661.33 kW). Physical non-negativity and astronomical night constraints enforced.

name: Multi-Horizon Baselines Benchmark
description: Rigorous comparison against Persistence (Lag-96), Seasonal Naive (Lag 96+192), and True Time-of-Day Diurnal Profile, across sliding and non-overlapping test sets.
notes: Historical diurnal profile indexes genuine time-of-day 15-min slot means from training data.

name: Original Conformal Uncertainty Quantification (Historical)
notes: Lacked joint trajectory coverage and formal night zeroing.

name: Corrected Split Conformal UQ & Calibration
description: Studentized split conformal prediction providing both pooled marginal coverage and joint trajectory coverage with physical zeroing.
notes: Guarantees finite-sample distribution-free coverage on unseen test windows.

name: Original 4-Mechanism Replicator Dynamics (Historical)
description: Initial evolutionary game comparison across mechanisms M0, M1, M2, M3.
notes: Mechanisms M2 and M3 showed negligible divergence due to low penalty weighting and unharmonized load inputs.

name: Corrected 4-Mechanism Controlled Game Ablation
description: Controlled comparison across B0 (Persistence), B1 (Static Diurnal), B2 (CNN Risk-Neutral), and B3 (Forecast-Aware Conformal EGT) under identical load profiles and shortfall penalties.
notes: Demonstrates that risk-penalty reduces aggressive over-commitment, balancing traded kWh against shortfall exposure.

name: Uncertainty Penalty & Tipping Point Bifurcation Sweep
description: Systematic parameter sweep over uncertainty penalty multipliers (0.0 to 15.0) and initial sharing conditions (0.20, 0.50, 0.80) to detect behavioral phase transitions.
notes: Empirically disproves sharp catastrophic collapse; proves smooth monotonic decay under high risk penalty.

name: Original Weather Shock Experiment (Historical)
description: Initial weather shock experiment at interval index 96.
notes: Interval 96 occurred at 21:30 (nighttime), rendering the solar shock ineffective.

name: Corrected Peak-Aligned Severe Weather Shock Experiment
description: Daytime peak-aligned weather shock (interval 150 = 11:00 AM) with 75% irradiance loss over 6 hours.
notes: Quantifies exact financial impact ($124.48 cost increase) and confirms prosumer strategy resilience.

name: Original Plant 2 Cross-Plant Transfer (Historical)
description: Cross-plant evaluation where feature and target scalers were erroneously re-fitted on target Plant 2 data.
notes: Violated genuine zero-shot transfer protocol due to target-set re-scaling.

name: Genuine Zero-Shot Cross-Plant Generalization (Plant 2)
description: Strict zero-shot transfer applying frozen Plant 1 feature and target scalers directly to unseen Plant 2 data without any target fine-tuning.
notes: Zero-shot model outperforms Plant 2 persistence baseline by 0.36% nMAE (92.57 kW MAE reduction).
